title: Provisional API Integration in Mistral Research Provider

proposed_action.description: Verify the Mistral API schema and update request parameters/response handling to eliminate the provisional TODO placeholders.

title: Deprecated Bot Directories Remaining in Codebase

proposed_action.description: Remove the deprecated bot directories from the active repository state, as they have been marked deprecated since 2026-07-05.

expected_benefit: Reduces repository bloat, prevents search confusion, and simplifies static analysis sweeps.

title: Dirty Working Tree with Untracked Diagnostic and Portal Artifacts

proposed_action.description: Add temporary diagnostic JSON dumps, logs, and markdown files to the root .gitignore and prune them from the working tree.

expected_benefit: Ensures clean commit histories, avoids accidental check-ins of private inputs/outputs, and makes status monitoring clearer.

title: Missing Event Bus Emission in Slack Handler

proposed_action.description: Implement the event bus or webhook emission block in slack_number_one_handler.py to satisfy integration completeness requirements.

expected_benefit: Ensures downstream services receive necessary operational telemetry from Slack command handling.

title: Hardcoded Default Model Router URL in Processing Config

proposed_action.description: Extract the default router URL fallback to an environment variable configuration template instead of hardcoding 'http://127.0.0.1:8891'.

expected_benefit: Enhances environment isolation and alignment across different platform staging configurations.
